name: feedback-failpath-1784271051
requirement: Add a read-only About screen showing the app version and a support email address.
proposed_spec:
## Overview
Add a read-only **About** screen to the application that surfaces the current app version number and a support email address. The screen contains only static, non-editable content and requires no backend integration. Its primary purpose is to give users quick access to version information (useful for bug reports) and a direct way to contact support.

---

## User stories

1. **As a user**, I want to view the current app version so that I can reference it when reporting bugs or seeking support.
2. **As a user**, I want to see a support email address so that I know how to contact the support team directly.
3. **As a user**, I want to tap/click the support email address so that my default email client opens pre-addressed to that address.

---

## Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then)

### Display app version
- **Given** I have navigated to the About screen,
- **When** the screen renders,
- **Then** the current app version string (e.g. `1.0.0 (build 42)`) is displayed in a clearly labelled, read-only field or row.

### Display support email
- **Given** I have navigated to the About screen,
- **When** the screen renders,
- **Then** the support email address (e.g. `support@example.com`) is displayed in a clearly labelled, read-only field or row.

### Tappable email link
- **Given** I am viewing the About screen,
- **When** I tap or click the support email address,
- **Then** the device's default email client opens with the `To` field pre-populated with the support email address.

### Static / read-only content
- **Given** I am viewing the About screen,
- **When** I interact with any content on the screen,
- **Then** no field is editable and no content can be modified by the user.

### Version sourced from build metadata
- **Given** the app is built,
- **When** the About screen is displayed,
- **Then** the version string is read automatically from the app's build metadata (e.g. `package.json` version + build number, `Info.plist`, `AndroidManifest`, or equivalent) and does **not** require a hardcoded string in the UI layer.

### Navigation entry point
- **Given** I am on the app's main settings or profile screen,
- **When** I tap the "About" menu item,
- **Then** I am taken to the About screen.

### Back navigation
- **Given** I am on the About screen,
- **When** I tap/click the back button (hardware or in-app),
- **Then** I am returned to the previous screen with no state changes.

---

## Screens

> No designs were provided. Implement using the existing app design system.

### About Screen
A single, scrollable (if needed) screen composed of:

| # | Element | Detail |
|---|---------|--------|
| 1 | **Screen title / header** | "About" — uses the standard app navigation header |
| 2 | **App name & icon** | Centred app logo/icon and app name at the top of the content area |
| 3 | **Version row** | Label: "Version" · Value: dynamically resolved version string (e.g. `1.0.0 (42)`) |
| 4 | **Support email row** | Label: "Support" · Value: tappable `mailto:` hyperlink styled as a link (e.g. `support@example.com`) |
| 5 | **Copyright notice** | Static text, e.g. `© 2024 Company Name. All rights reserved.` |

All rows follow the standard list/cell component used elsewhere in the app. No input fields, toggles, or action buttons beyond back navigation.

---

## API endpoints

_None._ All content is static or sourced from local build metadata. No API calls are required.

---

## Out of scope

- Editing or updating any information shown on the screen.
- Fetching version or support details from a remote API or CMS.
- Displaying a changelog, release notes, or update prompts.
- Deep-linking directly to the About screen from outside the app.
- Localisation / i18n of the support email address.
- In-app feedback forms or chat widgets.
- Links to Terms of Service or Privacy Policy (separate feature).
- Analytics or event tracking on this screen.

---

## Open questions

_None — the business requirement explicitly states no open questions. All assumptions are documented below for review:_

- **Support email address**: assumed to be `support@example.com`; replace with the real address before release.
- **Copyright year/entity**: assumed to be current year and company name; should be confirmed or made dynamic.
- **Navigation entry point**: assumed to live under Settings (or equivalent). If a different location is required, update routing accordingly.
- **Version format**: assumed to be `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (build NUMBER)`; adjust to match the project's existing convention.
